step2.title: Create campaigns and automations

trust.title: Built for companies that

isolation.title: Data isolated per company
isolation.text: Each organisation only sees its own data. Isolation is enforced in the database itself, not just in the app.

faq.title: Your questions,
faq.subtitle: Straight answers on how Kwanza Flow works.

q1.question: Which channels can I connect?
q1.answer: WhatsApp (through Meta's official API), Instagram (professional account) and Messenger (Facebook page). All of them arrive in the same Inbox.

q2.question: Will I lose my WhatsApp number?
q2.answer: WhatsApp connects through Meta's official API. We recommend a dedicated number. If you connect a number you already use in the WhatsApp phone app, that number stops working in the app.

q3.question: Can I send campaigns to all my contacts?
q3.answer: Campaigns reach the contacts in the segment who messaged you in the last 24 hours, which is what Meta allows for free-form messages. The others are left out and counted in the result. Anyone who asked not to receive automatic messages never receives them.

q4.question: What can I automate?
q4.answer: Pick a trigger (new contact, message received with a keyword, qualified lead, payment confirmed or popup filled in) and up to three actions: send a message, change the contact's stage or create a CRM task. Every run is logged.

q5.question: How do I install a popup on my website?
q5.answer: Create the popup in the dashboard, switch it on and paste a single line of code on your website. It works on any site and does not interfere with your design. You can limit the popup to your own domains.

q6.question: How does the AI work? Can it be wrong?
q6.answer: The AI answers using the business profile you fill in and does not make up what is not there. It qualifies contacts, sends payment links and books meetings. AI replies may contain mistakes: follow the conversations and take over when needed.

q7.question: Can several people use the platform?
q7.answer: Yes. Invite your team by e-mail (up to 5 people) as Owner, Manager or Agent. Agents handle conversations; only owners and managers manage campaigns, automations and popups.

q8.question: Is my data safe?
q8.answer: Each company only sees its own data, with isolation enforced in the database, and channel credentials are stored encrypted. You can delete your account and all data whenever you want.

q9.question: Do I need a card to try it? How much does it cost?
q9.answer: No. The free trial lasts 14 days and starts without a card. After that there is a single plan with everything included, and the price is shown before you subscribe.

q10.question: Can I cancel anytime?
q10.answer: Yes, with no lock-in. You cancel in the billing portal, at any time.
